cohort: 100 Syrian refugee and 100 Turkish pregnant women who gave birth at a tertiary referral center in Istanbul, Turkey, between January 2015 and August 2018.
finding: Syrian refugee women had lower hemoglobin, hematocrit, and mean corpuscular volume values compared to Turkish women, but these values remained above the lower limit for anemia during pregnancy; Syrian refugees also had lower rates of antenatal screening tests and fewer hospitalizations.
